Hi Sofie,

Thanks for reaching out! A chatbot for your webshop sounds like a great project.

The cost and go-live time depend a bit on what you have in mind — for example, which customer questions it should handle, whether it should connect to your product catalog or ordering system, and any other integrations.

I'd be happy to put together a concrete quote and timeline for you. Would a short call work to go over your requirements? Or feel free to send a few details by email, and I'll get back to you with an estimate.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

Michiel

Could you share a few time slots that work for you? If it's helpful, feel free to send over a short brief on the company beforehand so I can come prepared with some initial thoughts.

Looking forward to speaking.

Best regards,
Michiel

Hi Jan,

Thanks for reaching out! Yes, absolutely — appointment scheduling and answering customer questions are two areas where AI can add real value for a garage like yours. For example, an AI assistant can handle booking requests, send automatic reminders, and answer common questions (opening hours, services, availability) via your website, email, or WhatsApp. That frees up your team's time for the work that matters most.

I'd be happy to explore what this could look like for your garage. Would you be open to a short, no-obligation call? Just let me know what suits you.

Best regards,
Michiel
